title: Amodei says he never sought open-weight ban, but favors restricting Chinese models - TCR 07/28/26
description:
NOTE: metadata reconstructed manually on 2026-07-28; yt-dlp was bot-blocked for this video ("Sign in to confirm you're not a bot" on every player client). Title/duration/view_count from flat-playlist and oEmbed; content from the companion post at https://sharedsapience.com/the-century-report-july-28-2026/. Re-run yt-dlp later to replace with the real description if desired.

Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei published a direct rebuttal to the open-weight bloc (Nvidia, Hugging Face, Meta, Microsoft, Mistral), saying Anthropic has never advocated banning open-weight models, calling open models without dangerous capabilities "a public good," and backing a global model-safety-testing organization that would include China -- while drawing a China-specific line, naming the CCP as the most capable authoritarian actor that could use frontier systems to reach "permanent military superiority." Beijing's commerce ministry vowed "all necessary measures" against threatened US AI sanctions and accused American labs of distilling Chinese open models; Wired reported roughly ten camps inside the administration pulling export policy in different directions.

A report that China's homegrown deep-ultraviolet lithography tools reached mass production sent ASML plunging and knocked SK Hynix and Samsung down more than 10% on Tuesday, dragging the Kospi to a three-month low, a day after CXMT rose 466% on its Shanghai debut. Nvidia is reported to be discussing up to $250B in financing guarantees for OpenAI to lease Ohio data-center capacity, part of a lattice of deals exceeding $750B by one broad tally; Nvidia's credit-default swaps spiked. Oil fell roughly 6% in the same window after the US and Iran paused strikes, marking the chip rout as sector-specific.

Safe Superintelligence, Ilya Sutskever's alignment-first lab, broke two years of silence to announce a long-term Nvidia partnership -- an undisclosed investment "into multiple billions" plus access to the forthcoming Vera Rubin platform -- raising its available compute by roughly an order of magnitude. SSI has raised about $7B total, including a $2B round at a $32B valuation, from backers including Nvidia, Alphabet, a16z, and Sequoia.

Wiz published Atlas, which topped the CyberGym benchmark at 90.9% and surfaced more than 200 previously unknown zero-days in the Linux kernel, Kubernetes, gRPC, dnsmasq, gVisor, and containerd, each with an adversarially validated working exploit; a GitHub remote-code-execution bug (CVE-2026-3854) earned the largest bounty GitHub has ever paid. Microsoft shipped MAI-Cyber-1-Flash, its first model built to find and fix security flaws, processing more than a trillion security signals a day across 1.6 million customers inside the MDASH harness.

Three same-week papers put AI inside the physical make-step: MIT's DiffSyn, trained on 23,000+ synthesis recipes, proposed a route that produced a new thermally stable zeolite; an agent-designed peptide hydrogel, ViscoClamp, from Xi'an Jiaotong University repaired diabetic craniofacial bone across rats, rabbits, beagles, and rhesus macaques; and a machine-learning-guided vertical microrod array pulled 21.5%-efficient electricity (14.3 W/m2) from evaporating water, stable across thirty days.

Two open surfaces leaked the same day: shared Claude conversations turned up in Google and Bing search results -- missing a noindex tag despite a robots.txt request -- exposing crypto wallet keys and addresses, medical-billing dashboards, API keys, and login credentials, a repeat of failures at Anthropic last September and ChatGPT last year. An AI Forensics report found seven of the nine most popular Hugging Face image-editing Spaces produced topless images from a single instruction with no platform-level safeguard; a honeypot collected 1,000+ prompts a week, 83% seeking to undress a real person, 95% of those targeting women, and 6.7% targeting apparent children. The EU and UK are moving to ban nudifier apps by year's end.

Also: the EPA exempted "islanded" power plants serving data centers from Clean Air Act acid-rain limits on sulfur dioxide and nitrogen oxides; Moonshot AI released the full weights of Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter model, on Hugging Face under a revenue-tiered license -- the largest open-weight release yet.
